faq.q: What is Electric Fang Tattoo in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a tattoo parlor in the Stockyard neighborhood of Vice City. Rockstar says it offers over 50 tattoo designs for Jason and Lucia, all created by the Brooklyn-based artist collective FAILE.

faq.q: Is Electric Fang Tattoo available to everyone in GTA 6?
faq.a: No. It is confirmed as Ultimate Edition exclusive content, so it is not accessible to Standard Edition owners.

faq.q: Who designed the tattoos at Electric Fang Tattoo?
faq.a: FAILE, a real-world Brooklyn-based artist collective, created the parlor's tattoo designs. Rockstar names them directly in its breakdown of Ultimate Edition content.

faq.q: Where is Electric Fang Tattoo located in Vice City?
faq.a: It is located in the Stockyard neighborhood of Vice City, the same area confirmed for the streetwear store Stock 305.

faq.q: Can Jason and Lucia both get tattoos at Electric Fang Tattoo?
faq.a: Yes. Rockstar states the parlor's more than 50 designs are offered for both Jason and Lucia, though which specific designs go to each character has not been detailed.

faq.q: How many tattoo designs does Electric Fang Tattoo offer in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar states the parlor offers a series of over 50 tattoo designs. An exact count has not been given beyond that figure.

notKnown: The exact number of designs beyond the stated 'over 50'.
